subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Forex and Binary Options Scams
description: A micro-lesson that makes Forex and Binary Options Scams usable.

hook.text: Online forex trading platforms promise easy profits. Many are rigged from the start.

buildup.text: Victims open accounts, see fake profits on screen, and invest more to maximize 'gains.'

discovery.text: The platform is fake. Trades are simulated. Real money goes straight to the operator.

twist.text: Israel shut down a massive binary options industry in 2017 that had defrauded billions worldwide.

climax.text: These scams thrive because financial trading seems complex enough to justify strange results.

punchline.text: If the casino built your screen, the house always wins.

quiz.question: What was wrong with many binary options trading platforms?
options: The trades were fake — money went to the operator
